stock.error.KEY_INVALID: Your {provider} key was not accepted. Check it in Settings.
stock.error.NETWORK: No internet connection, or {provider} did not answer. Try again.
stock.error.CORS_BLOCKED: This site blocks direct download. A server is needed for this one.
stock.error.BAD_RESPONSE: {provider} sent something we could not read. Try another search.
stock.error.SIZE_LIMIT: This file is too big to add here.
stock.error.RATE_LIMITED: Too many searches. Try again later.
settings.offline.note.unpinned: Downloads once from Hugging Face into this browser, then works without internet. Files are checked by size only until the model files are pinned (npm run models:pin).
composition.title: Build video: {name}
composition.lead: Fill the media slots the AI asked for. Anything you leave empty is built as a dashed frame you can replace later.
composition.emptyFrames: {count} empty slot(s) will be built as frames you can fill later.
composition.missingVoice: The voice-over is not made yet. Make it in Record & create › Voice-over, then fill the voice-over slot.
composition.missingCaptions: Captions are not made yet. Use Auto captions after building.
composition.openConfirm: This replaces the open project. Export it first if you want to keep it.
composition.stockNoKey: Add a free stock key to search here.
camera.title: कैमरा
camera.note: The camera moves the whole scene while it plays and in the export. While you edit, the scene stays still unless you turn on Preview camera.
camera.keyframesOn: Animate this value (keyframe at the playhead)
camera.previewHint: While the camera is previewed, objects cannot be selected on the canvas. Turn Preview camera off to edit.
composition.ready: Ready to build. {count} item(s) to fill or check when you build.
probe.rotatedNote: “{name}” was filmed rotated {degrees}°. It is shown upright automatically, in the preview and in the export.
probe.vfrNote: “{name}” has a variable frame rate (common for phone videos). Playback and export follow the file’s own timing, so sound stays in sync. Nothing needs fixing.
probe.videoCodecError: “{name}” uses the video format {codec}, which this browser cannot play. Convert it to MP4 (H.264) or WebM and import it again.
probe.audioCodecError: “{name}” uses the sound format {codec}, which this browser cannot play. Convert it to MP3, AAC or WAV and import it again.
relink.title: Reconnect media
relink.intro: {count} media files used in this project are not in this browser. Pick each file, or pick the folder they are in. Your clips, timing and animation stay as they are.
relink.missing: Missing: shown as a placeholder until you reconnect it.
relink.readyUnmatched: Will use “{name}”. Its name and size are different: check it is the right file.
relink.match.name: name
relink.wrongKind: “{name}” is {kind} file; this one needs {needed} file.
relink.unreadable: “{name}” could not be read. Try another copy of the file.
relink.noMatch: Not found in that folder. Pick the file yourself.
relink.ambiguous: Several files in that folder match. Pick the right one yourself.
relink.saveFailed: The files could not be saved in this browser. Nothing was changed; try again.
relink.skipped: {count} media files are still missing. They show as placeholders.
mixer.title: मिक्सर
mixer.empty: Add a video or a sound to see its lane here.
mixer.note: Levels move while the video plays. Solo is only for listening; export ignores it.
u5.keysHint: Move the playhead over the clip and add a keyframe to change the volume over time.
u5.keysOn: Keyframes set the volume over time; Volume above no longer applies.
u5.denoiseNote: Runs in this browser: the first use downloads about {size} MB once, and your audio is never uploaded. Works on sources up to 5 minutes.
u5.denoiseTooLong: Reduce noise works on sources up to 5 minutes. This one is longer.
u5.denoiseFailed: Noise reduction could not run, so this clip may sound different. Turn it off or try again.
mask.title: Masks
mask.hint: Show only part of this layer. Drag the dots on the canvas to change the shape.
mask.name: Mask {n}: {type}
mask.keyCount: {n} shape keyframes. Dragging a dot changes the keyframe at the playhead.
mask.keyNone: No keyframes: the shape stays the same over time.
blend.unsupported: This layer asks for the blend mode "{mode}", which this editor does not know, so it is drawn as Normal.
chroma.title: Chroma key
chroma.cpuNotice: Your browser cannot use the graphics card for this, so it runs on the processor. It works, but playback may be slower.
chroma.pickHint: Click the colour you want to remove on the canvas. Press Escape to stop.
chroma.qualityHint: Fast previews at a lower size while you edit. Export always uses full quality.
fonts.offline: You're offline. Fonts already saved on this device still work.
fonts.coverage.ok: Every character of this text is in {font}.
fonts.coverage.missing: {font} has no letters for: {chars}. Try a font marked Hindi.
fonts.coverage.unknown: The characters of {font} can't be checked here.
fonts.error.offline: Not saved on this device, and you're offline.
fonts.error.failed: This font could not be downloaded.
fonts.error.project: The font {font} could not load. A similar font is shown until it does.
textx.resolved.rtl: Reads right to left: Start is the right edge.
voiceover.title: Voice-over
voiceover.placeholder: Type what the voice should say
voiceover.added: Added to the timeline at the playhead.
voiceover.name: Voice-over {n}
voiceover.browserNote: Browser voices can be heard but not saved. Pick another voice engine to save.
voiceover.hindiHint: Hindi needs a paid voice (Sarvam / Google / ElevenLabs): add a key in Settings.
voiceover.error.key: The voice service needs a valid key. Check it in Settings.
voiceover.error.limit: The voice service is busy. Try again in a little while.
voiceover.error.network: The voice service could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
voiceover.error.language: This voice does not speak that language. Pick another voice.
voiceover.error.failed: The voice-over could not be made. Try again.
rec.toTimeline: Also add to the timeline at the playhead
rec.screenNote: When you press Record, your browser asks which screen, window or tab to share.
rec.pipNote: The camera is placed in a corner of the screen video (picture in picture).
rec.perm.prompt: {device}: your browser will ask when you press Record.
rec.perm.denied: {device}: blocked. Click the icon left of the web address, allow it, then Retry.
rec.error.UNSUPPORTED: This browser cannot record. Try the latest Chrome or Edge.
rec.error.PERMISSION_DENIED: Recording was not allowed. Click the icon left of the web address, allow the camera, microphone or screen, then Retry.
rec.error.DEVICE_NOT_FOUND: No camera or microphone was found. Connect one, then Retry.
rec.error.DEVICE_BUSY: The camera or microphone is used by another app. Close it, then Retry.
rec.error.STORAGE_LIMIT: The recording got too large and was stopped. Try a shorter take.
rec.error.FAILED: The recording could not be made. Try again.
nest.name: Nested clip
nest.ungroupBlocked: This is a nested clip. Use Un-nest to bring its clips back.
captions.title: Auto captions
captions.noClips: Add a video or audio clip to the timeline first. You can still import an SRT or VTT file below.
captions.engine.needsKeyNote: Add your key in Settings to use this engine.
captions.hint.engine: Pick an engine that is ready, or set one up with the button beside it.
captions.error.engine: This engine is not ready yet. Set it up in Settings first.
captions.error.noMedia: The media file for this clip is not in this browser. Import it again, then try once more.
captions.error.noCues: No words were found to make captions from.
captions.copyBlocked: The clipboard is blocked. Select the text and copy it.
captions.added: Added {count} captions on a new Captions lane.
